entities.summary: Bryanne Stewart is a former professional tennis player from Australia. She has been ranked World No. 16 in doubles and has won three doubles titles. In singles, she reached the third round of the Australian Open in 2000. Bryanne Stewart was a athletes & competitors from Sydney (b. 1979-12-09, Sydney).
